headline: SBI Questions RBI's Rs 2.5 Lakh Crore Liquidity Injection Amid Tight Policy
summary: The Reserve Bank of India's injection of Rs 2.5 lakh crore into the banking system through repo auctions has sparked questions from the State Bank of India over its liquidity management approach, given the central bank's tighter monetary policy stance.
why: Central bank repo auctions adjust system liquidity, influencing short-term interest rates and bank lending margins in the broader financial sector.

impacts.name: State Bank of India
impacts.why: Large liquidity infusions alter banking system reserves and affect overall credit growth dynamics.
